limits: 337 pages obtained does not mean 337 pages read. Only listed sections were inspected.
The 2004 edited volume is distinct from Archana Nayak’s 98-page Sahitya Akademi monograph published in 2021.
No claim that the film has no literary source, or that a particular story is absent from the whole volume.
No source-story choice can be made merely from a contents title, thematic resemblance, or the author’s general biography.
